title: The Executed Sage Who Was Reincarnated as a Lich Started an All-Out War
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: The sage Dwight and the Hero defeat the Demon Lord, but the people they saved accuse them of becoming the next Demon Lords and throw them into the Valley of the Dead. Dwight survives as a skeletal lich, grieving the dead Hero, and climbs out with an undead army to wage war on a world he sees as corrupt, aiming to build the peace the Hero dreamed of (Comikey blurb via AniList and MangaUpdates; Binge Senpai summary).
life_message: When a corrupt world betrays its saviors, overwhelming power can be used to force the just world they hoped for (the story's premise, not verified as endorsed).
